picks.title: California investigates Nvidia over whether chip exports ended up in China
picks.rationale: Geopolitics axis, new formal action: California's attorney general opened an investigation and subpoenaed Nvidia over possible AI-chip diversion to China and investor disclosures. This is the first state-level enforcement step in the Megaspeed story.
picks.excerpt: California's attorney general has opened an investigation and subpoenaed Nvidia over whether its AI chips were diverted to China and whether the company misled investors, saying the Megaspeed scandal 'raises bright red flags'.

picks.title: 베선트 "미중 정상, AI 군사 결정에 인간 개입 합의"
picks.rationale: Geopolitics axis: per Treasury Secretary Bessent, the US and Chinese leaders agreed to keep humans in the loop on all AI-driven military decisions. That is a reported summit outcome, not the pre-summit preview published on 11-12. No signed text has been released, so the claim is attributed to Bessent.
picks.excerpt: 스콧 베선트 미 재무장관이 CNBC 인터뷰에서 트럼프 대통령과 시진핑 주석이 AI를 활용한 모든 군사적 결정에 항상 인간이 개입해야 하며 주요 군사작전에서 자율 작동을 허용하지 않기로 합의했다고 밝혔다. 서명된 공동성명 텍스트는 아직 없음.

picks.title: Policies on the Use of Generative Super Intelligence in Agency Adjudication; Request for Comments
picks.rationale: Policy axis, primary document: ACUS is seeking public comment on rules for generative AI use by federal adjudicators, staff and parties, and the input will shape a government-wide best-practice recommendation that people can respond to now.
picks.excerpt: The Administrative Conference of the United States requests public comment on policies for use of generative AI by agency adjudicators, staff, parties and representatives in federal agency adjudications; responses feed an ACUS best-practice recommendation.

picks.title: 2026 Elections: Taiwan tells Meta of China accounts to influence polls
picks.rationale: Elections axis: ahead of the Nov. 28 local elections, Taiwan's government formally flagged about 2,700 Threads accounts to Meta as a suspected Chinese influence campaign that spread more than 2,150 AI-generated videos. It is a new government-to-platform action, separate from the 11-13 police deepfake tally.
picks.excerpt: Taiwan flagged nearly 2,700 Threads accounts to Meta as a suspected Chinese influence campaign before the Nov. 28 local elections; internal reports say ~260 accounts spread 2,150+ AI-generated videos with 2.35M interactions. Meta says many were already disabled.

picks.title: Artificial intelligence (AI) in social care
picks.rationale: Policy axis, primary document: the UK government published non-statutory guidance for using AI in children's and adults' social care in England, which directly affects vendors and providers building AI tools for the sector.
picks.excerpt: UK government publishes non-statutory guidance on the use of artificial intelligence in children's and adults' social care in England.

https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2.new_action: California Attorney General opened a state investigation and issued a subpoena to Nvidia (new enforcement action by a new authority).

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/AKR2026112100.new_action: Treasury Secretary Bessent announced the summit outcome: US-China leaders agreed to human control over AI military decisions (11-12 card was only a pre-summit preview).
